turns.user: Explain why a lock prevents two writers from colliding.
turns.assistant:
Lock = one key. Only key-holder writes. No key, wait.

Why collision happen without lock:
- Writer A reads value. Writer B reads same value. Both compute. Both write back. One overwrites other. Lost update.
- Or interleave mid-write. Half A data, half B data. Corrupt state.

Lock fixes:
1. Writer A grabs lock (acquire). Others blocked.
2. A does read-modify-write. Whole thing atomic — no one peek mid-flight.
3. A releases lock. Next writer grabs.

Key idea: **serialize** the critical section. Concurrent access becomes one-at-a-time. Only one writer touch shared data at once, so no interleave, no lost update.

Lock give **mutual exclusion** — "mutex". Turns racy region into safe queue.
